title: Freak Alley Gallery
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: In 2002, the first drawing was created by Colby Akers on the back alley doorway of Moon's Cafe. Over the years, the Gallery blossomed into the true work of art it is today. Now, the murals and graffiti-inspired artwork extend well beyond the single doorway; artwork can be seen throughout the entire alley.
